title: This Rover Found Rocks in Mars' Jezero Crater Were Altered by Water Three Separate Times, Overturning the Simple Ancient Lake Theory
description: Scientists expected to find the quiet remains of an ancient lakeshore. Instead, a rover's laser revealed rocks with a far more turbulent past, one that challenges what we thought we knew about water on Mars.

title: 518-Million-Year-Old Fossil Challenges What We Thought Starfish Came From
description: A creature preserved for 518 million years hints that the starfish family began with tentacles, challenging a long-standing picture of its earliest ancestor. Fossils discovered in southwestern China suggest that an animal called Yujingia glutenotunica lived close to the evolutionary roots of ambulacrarians, the group that includes starfish, sea urchins, and acorn worms. title: Dinosaurs Once Roamed Telangana? Meet The Mancherial Region Hiding Fossils And Ancient History
description: Vemanapalli in Telangana’s Mancherial district is known for dinosaur remains, fossils, lush forests and Kakatiya-era statues, offering a rare glimpse into the region’s ancient past
